subject: Baseline per-1M IO rates + supported models (hosted API) — request
messages:
From: Sanjay Rao <sanjay.rao@helionhealth.com>
To: rafael_mendes@redwood.inference; ben_carter@redwood.inference
Date: Sun, 20 Jul 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: per-1M token IO rates and supported models for hosted API

Hi Rafael,

We are evaluating Redwood for a pilot and need a concise baseline for finance + architecture to review. Can you send your standard per-1M token rates split by input vs output (IO), and a current list of hosted models you certify/endorse for production? Specifically:

- Standard per-1M rates for common model tiers (small, medium, large, chat-optimized). Please show input vs output pricing if they differ.
- Which hosted models are supported/verified in your catalog today (including quantized variants)?
- Discount/commit bands (if any) and how quantization or batching affects pricing.
- Any minimums or recommended commit path for pilots -> paid prod.

Rough context: Helion expects ~300M tokens/month in year-1 if pilot converts; current estimator is ~30% prompt/input and ~70% completion/output. We care about predictable unit economics and want to know if a committed discount makes sense. Also flag anything we should know about data residency / SOC2 evidence for an initial security screen.

Thanks,
Sanjay Rao
Director, ML Platforms
Helion Health

--
Attachment: none in this message
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.inference>
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay.rao@helionhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.inference>
Date: Sun, 20 Jul 2025 10:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: per-1M token IO rates and supported models for hosted API

Hi Sanjay —

Thanks for the clear ask and context; happy to provide a straight baseline and a recommended next step. I attached our concise hosted rate sheet (redwood-hosted-ratecard-v1.pdf) and a short commit/disc path worksheet. Quick summary below (blended baseline examples):

Baseline (public hosted API, list prices per 1M tokens) — illustrative:
- Small models (e.g., mosaic-ml-13b): $0.50 input / $1.00 output per 1M
- Medium models (e.g., redwood-chat-7b): $1.00 input / $2.00 output per 1M
- Large chat-optimized (e.g., redwood-chat-34b): $2.50 input / $5.00 output per 1M
- High-capacity (specialized LLMs like Falcon-40B): $4.00 input / $8.00 output per 1M

Notes:
- We price input vs output separately because completion tokens drive most compute; the examples above are list rates and assume no committed discount.
- Quantized variants (q4/q8) are typically cheaper in practice due to lower GPU footprint; we list supported quantized variants in the attachment.
- Batching and prefix/KV caching can materially lower real-world cost; rates above do not assume cache benefits.

Commit/discount quick guide (attached sheet has full bands):
- No commit: list above
- 6–12 month pilot commit (≥10M tokens/mo): ~10% off list
- 50–200M tokens/mo commit: ~18–25% (tiered)
- Strategic enterprise commits (≥200M tokens/mo or multi-year): bespoke pricing + SLA

Security/data residency: we are SOC 2 Type II; we can provide our SOC 2 report and summary evidence. Hosted API has region controls (us/eu) — if Helion requires VPC/private deployment that's a different product (Redwood Private) and pricing differs.

Couple of clarifying questions so I can give a tighter blended price:
1) Can you confirm the approximate prompt/completion split (you mentioned ratio — is 30/70 a stable assumption)?
2) Which models are you likely to use in pilot (chat vs standard decoder) — production model choice changes the blended number.

I looped in Ben Carter (cc) from commercial who can run a formal quote and map the commit path. If helpful, we can do a 30-min call tomorrow to walk through the attachment and sketch a pilot commit.

Best,
Rafael Mendes
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
rafael_mendes@redwood.inference

Attachments: redwood-hosted-ratecard-v1.pdf, commit-discount-path.xlsx
From: Sanjay Rao <sanjay.rao@helionhealth.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.inference>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.inference>, Kara Lim <kara.lim@helionhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jul 2025 08:19:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: per-1M token IO rates and supported models for hosted API

Hi Rafael — thanks, that helps. A few clarifications from our side:

- The 30/70 split is our current estimate (30% input, 70% output). We expect output-heavy workloads because many flows generate long completions (summaries, patient-facing messages).
- For pilot we'll likely evaluate 2 model classes: a chat-optimized medium (for conversational flows) and a smaller encoder-decoder for embeddings and light NLU tasks.
- Target pilot volume: 25–50M tokens/month initially ramping to 150–300M if pilot converts.

Questions:
1) Can you provide an example blended per-1M IO price for our projected mix (assume 40% medium chat, 60% small models, using your list rates + a 10% pilot commit)? A single blended number will help my finance team.
2) Does the hosted pricing include KV caching and prefix cache behavior out of box, or is that an add-on/feature tied to Dedicated?
3) For quantized variants — are they available on hosted or only for Dedicated/Private?
4) Please attach SOC 2 summary and indicate if the hosted region options include us-east and eu-west.

If you can send the blended example and SOC2 evidence, I can share with procurement. Happy to take a short call too — Kara and I are available Tue afternoon.

Thanks,
Sanjay

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.inference>
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay.rao@helionhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.inference>
Date: Tue, 22 Jul 2025 11:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: per-1M token IO rates and supported models for hosted API

Sanjay — quick answers and a blended example below. See attached SOC 2 summary & region matrix.

Quick points:
- Hosted includes automatic KV/prefix caching and standard batching heuristics out of box for most endpoints; Dedicated gives more control over cache size/pin policies but is not required for caching benefits.
- Quantized variants: we support q4/q8 on hosted for many open models (we list which ones in the ratecard). Some very large models (≥40B) only expose quantized variants on Dedicated due to memory constraints.
- Regions: hosted has us-east and eu-west today; we can guarantee residency via regional endpoints.

Blended example for your projected pilot (assumptions: 30% input / 70% output, 40% medium chat @ list medium rates, 60% small model @ list small rates, and a 10% pilot commit discount applied):
- List small model blended rate (avg): input $0.50 / output $1.00 per 1M
- List medium chat blended rate (avg): input $1.00 / output $2.00 per 1M

Weighted blended list before discount:
- Input blended = 0.6 * $0.50 + 0.4 * $1.00 = $0.70 per 1M input
- Output blended = 0.6 * $1.00 + 0.4 * $2.00 = $1.40 per 1M output

Apply 10% pilot discount (example):
- Input = $0.70 * 0.90 = $0.63 per 1M input
- Output = $1.40 * 0.90 = $1.26 per 1M output

For your stated ~150M tokens/month mix (30/70), the blended per-1M across IO (weighted by token counts) would be:
- Overall blended per-1M = (0.30 * $0.63) + (0.70 * $1.26) = $1.09 per 1M tokens (this is a simple blended-unit view to get finance moving; final quote will be token-type broken).

Next steps I propose:
1) Ben (cc) can open a formal pilot quote in HubSpot and include the exact bands for 3-6-12 month commits.
2) I’ll schedule a 30-min call Tue 2pm PT to walk through the ratecard, attach SOC 2 summary, and confirm which models you want in scope.

Ben — can you confirm a pilot quote around the 25–50M initial band and the 10% pilot discount?

Thanks — Rafael

Rafael Mendes
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
